in_sanskrit.name: देवक्षी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has divine eyes or wealth

in_marathi.name: Devakshi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devakshi is a name of divine origin. It is derived from two words, 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Akshi' meaning 'Eyes'. Hence, Devakshi means 'God's Eyes'.

in_bengali.name: Devakshi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Eyes
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devakshi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Devakshi is a name of divine origin. It is derived from two words, 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Akshi' meaning 'Eyes'. Hence, Devakshi means 'God's Eyes'.
